title: We're making Bunny DNS free: because a faster internet won't build itself
summary: Bunny.net announced they are making their DNS service completely free to help build a faster internet infrastructure, removing the paywall for their DNS platform that was previously available only in paid tiers.
problem_solved: Eliminates cost barriers for accessing fast, reliable DNS services, making premium internet infrastructure accessible to everyone.
why_valuable: By offering free DNS, Bunny.net enables developers and small businesses to leverage high-performance DNS without budget constraints, potentially improving global internet speed and reliability.
